newsitem.title: USA: Soligen cash sufficient through September.
newsitem.headline: Soligen cash sufficient through September.

text.p: Soligen Technologies Inc said Thursday it filed an 8-K form with the Securities and Exchange Commission indicating its cash on hand was sufficient to sustain operations through at least September 30.
Previously, the company had said cash was sufficient to fund operations through June.

On Thursday, the company said it also believes it may have sufficient funds to last past September 30, due to recent activities including a tender offer for the early exercise of existing warrants and discussions concerning the establishment of a line of credit.
A Soligen spokesman said it expected to obtain a line of credit as early as next week.
Soligen makes technology for metal parts fabrication.
